ReplayDF
	

ReplayDF is a dataset for evaluating the impact of replay attacks on audio deepfake detection systems. 
It features re-recorded bona-fide and synthetic speech derived from M-AILABS and MLAAD v5, using 109 unique speaker-microphone combinations across six languages and four TTS models in diverse acoustic environments.
This dataset reveals how such replays can significantly degrade the performance of state-of-the-art detectors.
